water_sound.conclusion: The current candidate does not feed the squared distance. This is a one-item-lag selection defect in the shipped binary, not a decompiler error and not nearest-point selection.
water_sound.no_selection: Empty list, or all distance comparisons failing (NaN/overflow/infinite or >=float.MaxValue), leaves output zero. Missing camera/master/sandbanker/verts/component throws null-reference; it does not silently retain the previous frame position.

sandbank_stage2.guard: Outer pass==0; after cyclic rotation iA%2==1 and iB%2==1 and iC%2==0; A.y>0 or B.y>0; higher-priority A.y==0 && B.y==0 && C.y>0 branch is tested first. No distance comparison, clamp, nearest-neighbor search or C.y test is added to this correction branch.
sandbank_stage2.source_vectors: A=verts[iA], B=verts[iB], C=verts[iC] from current triangle; u=(B-A) with u.y=0; normal=Normalize((u.z,0,-u.x)); point-vector=C-A.
sandbank_stage2.target: Only C even-index carrier at vertex index iC receives this correction after accumulating the triangle sweep. A and B are not moved by this branch.
sandbank_stage2.normalization: If length((u.z,0,-u.x))>float32 threshold, divide by that length; otherwise Vector3.zero. For a degenerate/very short horizontal edge normal is zero and this branch adds zero.
sandbank_stage2.iteration: Triangles visited backwards in triples. When neither branch matches, both indices and positions rotate A,B,C→B,C,A, up to three orientations. A matching branch stops that triangle rotation. After each outer pass apply displacement[k] to verts[2*k] and reset displacement[k] to zero; outer pass repeats three times, but this 0.3/0.6 correction is enabled only for pass0.
sandbank_stage2.interpretation: Horizontal signed point-to-directed-edge distance target0.3 with relaxation0.6. If d<0.3 push +normal; if d>0.3 pull -normal; d==0.3 zero correction. It is not Euclidean endpoint distance or a proximity cutoff.

zero_height_endpoints.guard: A.y==0 && B.y==0 && C.y>0, checked before the pass0 near-edge rule, on all three outer passes and all three cyclic orientations.
zero_height_endpoints.formula: u=SetY(B-A,0);delta=0.3*u; if iA%2==0:displacement[iA/2]+=delta; if iB%2==0:displacement[iB/2]-=delta; then finish this triangle.
zero_height_endpoints.target: A and B are independently eligible only when even indexed. C is unchanged by this rule. Displacement accumulates until end-of-pass flush to verts[2*k].
zero_height_endpoints.limits: No normalization, projection onto another vector, sign test, clamped length, distance threshold, or C index parity guard. Edge length scales the displacement: a length2 edge yields magnitude0.6 at each eligible endpoint.

limits: Six-round smoothing, the later triangle height-cap rules and stage3 are handled in corresponding reports; this artifact now includes both three-pass local branches and strip collapse/diagonal selection.

vector_inequality.formula: For finite values: Vector3.op_Inequality(a,b) = ((a-b).sqrMagnitude >= float32(0x2edbe6fe)). COMISS threshold,squaredDistance followed SETBE also yields true for unordered/NaN.

strip_repair.iteration: After six-round smoothing, lift every odd vertex by 0.186*Vector3.up, then scan triangle index groups backwards six indices per strip. Read iA=T[s],iB=T[s+1],iC=T[s+2],iD=T[s+4] and snapshot A/B/C/D coordinates.
strip_repair.original_triangles: (iA,iB,iC),(iC,iD,iA), established by the six List.Add operations in Iterate stage1.
strip_repair.flags: fA=Dot(D-A,savedNormalized[iA/2])<0; fB=Dot(C-B,savedNormalized[iB/2])<0. SavedNormalized is the separate local_58 list populated by the smoothing setup, not the fresh Cross result.
strip_repair.unused_cross: The original executes Cross(Vector3.up,SetY(C-D,0)) at0x1081815b into stack buffer ebp-0x4a8, then immediately reads savedNormalized[iA/2]. No later instruction in the strip block reads that Cross buffer. The flags do not perform a segment-crossing test using this result.
strip_repair.flip_rule: if (!fA && fB) flip unconditionally; if (fA && fB) flip only when SquaredMagnitude(B-D)<SquaredMagnitude(A-C); all other cases retain original triangles. Strict comparison includes full xyz.

vertex_collapse_cases.triangles: flipped only if B-D shorter than A-C

strip_repair.conclusion: This block includes directional endpoint collapse and unconditional topology repair. Only the both-negative flag case prefers the shorter diagonal, so describing the entire block as shortest-diagonal selection omits behavior.
